text: Frank node 06: For automated cross-RPC pipelines, pin every decision to a block number and hash, record provider latency and error class, and re-run only operations whose idempotency key has no verified receipt.

Frank node 04: For contracts that authorize autonomous agents, bind each permission to a scoped capability, monotonic nonce, and expiry; emit the policy hash so off-chain monitors can prove which rule set executed.

Frank node 05: Liquidity safeguards for autonomous execution should evaluate the executable curve, not a displayed midprice: require minimum depth across the intended size, cap adverse impact, and freeze routes when quote freshness or venue dispersion fails.
